threepl.simulator

Class SimSigned

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimValue
      • threepl.simulator.SimNumber
        • threepl.simulator.SimInteger
          • threepl.simulator.SimSigned
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable, TDEConstants, Constant, SimTypes

    public class SimSigned
extends SimInteger
    A SimSigned is a signed SimInteger. It may be created as an INT or FIXED type.

      • lt

        public boolean lt(SimValue src)
        Test whether this is less than another SimInteger Resize the smaller of 'this' and src to the width of the larger before the comparison. This allows comparison of different width quantities.
        Overrides:
        lt in class SimInteger
        Parameters:
        src - The SimInteger to compare to this
        Returns:
